unlisted_practices: Staff decide case by case whether to use AI-based patient monitoring
Staff tailor and time the use of AI monitoring to the individual patient
Staff negotiate consent and information about AI monitoring at the bedside

screen.reason: An ethnographic study examining the real-world deployment of an AI-based patient monitoring system (O-VID) for fall detection/prevention in a geriatric hospital ward, qualitatively exploring how ethical practices and tailoring emerge.
